# content-automerge allowlist — THE source of truth for what may merge with no
# human review.
#
# `.github/workflows/auto-merge-content.yml` reads THIS FILE (from `main`, via
# the API — never from the PR head) and enables GitHub auto-merge only when
# every changed path in a PR starts with one of the ALLOW prefixes below AND
# none of them starts with a DENY (`!`) prefix. One path outside the allow set,
# or one path under a deny prefix, and the PR waits for a founder. That is the
# fail-safe direction.
#
# ⚠️ EDITING THIS FILE CHANGES MERGE AUTHORITY. Adding an allow line means bots
# can land that path with nobody looking.
#
# WIDENED 2026-08-11 (Wyatt directive — docs/decisions.md): app code
# (`apps/web/app/`, `apps/web/components/`, `apps/web/lib/`) and shared
# packages (`packages/`) now auto-merge too. (The `apps/web/lib/` grant was
# narrowed to `apps/web/lib/longlive/` on 2026-08-12 — P0 fix #1972, see the
# App-code block below.) Reasoning: a human-merge gate that
# nobody actually exercises is theater — "honestly we're not reviewing any
# code." The real gate for app code is FULL required CI green, not a rubber
# stamp: the `build` check runs typecheck + lint + the whole test suite +
# validate:content + check:generated + check:content-inert +
# check:automerge-allowlist + check:content-ownership + check:no-downgrade +
# content:coverage + build + check:budget:seed, all in one required job. Auto-
# merge waits on that; a red anything blocks the merge.
#
# The DENY (`!`) lines below carve specific sub-paths back OUT of a broad allow —
# they always win over an allow. They are how `apps/web/app/` can flow while
# `apps/web/app/api/`, `/privacy`, `/terms` do not.
#
# STILL HUMAN-ONLY (not widened, on purpose — this is NOT about code review, it
# is about not letting the system rewrite its own safety or ship irreversible /
# counsel-needing changes unreviewed):
#   - `.github/**`, `scripts/**`, `package.json`, lockfiles, config — the gate
#     and what CI runs. A gate that can widen itself is not a gate. (Barred by
#     NEVER_ALLOWLIST; also simply not allowed here.)
#   - `apps/web/app/api/**` — the request-handling / data layer. Held because
#     E2E is 100% red (#669): app-code auto-merge currently has NO behavioural
#     regression net beyond unit + typecheck + build, which is adequate for view
#     components but thin for request handlers. Revisit when #669 is green.
#   - ANY `route.ts`/`.tsx`/`.js` under `apps/web/app/**` — a Next.js route
#     handler executes server-side and is NOT limited to `/api/` (P0 #1972).
#     Enforced by the content guard, not a path line (a prefix can't match a
#     `*/route.ts` suffix).
#   - The top-level `apps/web/lib/*` files — the server data layer
#     (`vault.ts`), the CSP module (`security-headers.mjs`), and the top-level
#     hooks/utils. Only the `apps/web/lib/longlive/` display subtree auto-merges.
#   - `apps/web/lib/longlive/mood-client.ts` — reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
#     (denied by path, and by the content guard).
#   - `apps/web/next.config.*`, any `apps/web/middleware.*` — deploy/security
#     config (barred in NEVER_ALLOWLIST; also caught by the content guard).
#   - Server Actions (`"use server"`) and `server-only` modules anywhere —
#     caught by the content guard, since they can live in any file.
#   - `apps/web/app/privacy/**`, `apps/web/app/terms/**` and any legal lib —
#     legal surfaces need counsel, not a code review.
#   - `supabase/migrations/**` — irreversible schema (already NEVER_ALLOWLIST).
#   - the rest of `apps/web/public/**` — bot-picked media gets human eyes
#     (2026-07-28), EXCEPT the `apps/web/public/social/` carve-out below.
#
# The `apps/web/public/social/` exception is checker-gated (docs/decisions.md
# 2026-08-11): that path is a plain prefix match here same as any other entry,
# but the `enable` job applies EXTRA per-file constraints to it (must be
# .png/.jpg/.jpeg, ≤1.5MB, a regular git blob — not a symlink/submodule) that
# this file has no way to express. A file under that prefix failing those
# constraints still declines, same as any other non-content path would.
#
# THE SELF-AMENDMENT BAR (2026-08-11). Some paths are not a judgement call and
# CI refuses them outright: `.github/**`, `scripts/**`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`,
# `docs/agents/**`, `docs/decisions.md`, `docs/proposals/**`, `docs/specs/**`,
# `docs/content-ops/**`, `package.json`, lockfiles, config, migrations, and
# `apps/web/public/**` (EXCEPT the `apps/web/public/social/` carve-out above).
# Those paths change *what merges with nobody looking, or what agents are
# permitted to do* — allowlisting one would let a bot PR widen its own authority
# and land the widening unreviewed. The mechanism that decides what merges
# without a human must itself always need a human. The full list and the reason
# per path: NEVER_ALLOWLIST in scripts/check-automerge-allowlist.mjs; the single
# narrowing (the social carve-out) is NEVER_ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS there.
#
# Format: one path prefix per line, matched with a literal `startsWith`.
#   - `#` starts a comment; blank lines ignored.
#   - A leading `!` makes the line a DENY prefix: a changed file under it is
#     NEVER auto-mergeable, even if an allow prefix also matches. Deny wins.
#   - Directory prefixes MUST end in `/` (`docs/audits` would also match
#     `docs/auditsX/`).
#   - Every ALLOW entry must name a path that actually exists. DENY entries need
#     not exist yet (`!apps/web/app/terms/` is a forward-looking guard).
#   - A broad allow that would otherwise sweep in a NEVER_ALLOWLIST-barred area
#     is only permitted when a DENY prefix fully covers that barred area — so
#     `apps/web/app/` is allowed BECAUSE `!apps/web/app/api/` (etc.) deny it
#     back out. See barredPrefixes() in check-automerge-allowlist.mjs.
#
# `npm run check:automerge-allowlist` (CI, in `build`) enforces all of the
# above AND that every apps/web/lib/longlive/*.generated.ts is either listed
# here or explicitly excluded in scripts/check-automerge-allowlist.mjs. A new
# generated file therefore cannot go silently un-auto-mergeable — which is the
# bug this file exists to prevent (PRs #1891/#1762 sat a week because
# theories.generated.ts was never added to the old inline list).

# ── Seed data: the authored source of truth for all Vault content. ──────────
supabase/seed/

# ── Social queue: drafted posts (per docs/decisions.md 2026-07-25). ─────────
social/queue/

# ── Social poster state ledger (ADDED 2026-08-12 — docs/decisions.md, issue
#    #2031). `social/posted/` and `social/failed/` are machine-written
#    BOOKKEEPING, not content: the poster records "this item posted / failed"
#    by renaming queue files into them via a state PR that its whole design
#    assumes lands within minutes. These paths were missing from this list, so
#    after PR #1900 made the enable job disarm auto-merge on every declined
#    PR, every success-recording state PR stranded open — main kept saying
#    "still queued" and the next run posted the item AGAIN (the 2026-08-11/12
#    Instagram triple-post, issue #2031). Stranding these PRs is the dangerous
#    direction: the ledger of what already went out MUST land fast. No content
#    decision is made on these paths — the content gate stays `social/queue/`
#    (check-drafts) upstream; these only record what the poster already did. ──
social/posted/
social/failed/

# ── Audit reports written by the content-engine runners. ────────────────────
docs/audits/

# ── Weekly deterministic merch revenue report. ─────────────────────────────
docs/ops/MERCH-REVENUE.json

# ── Social images: ONE narrow exception to the apps/web/public/** rule above
#    (docs/decisions.md 2026-08-11 — checker-gated, per-file constraints
#    enforced by the workflow, not by this file). A queue item's own
#    dedicated photo, already validated by scripts/social/check-drafts.mjs's
#    media rules in the check-drafts job. ────────────────────────────────────
apps/web/public/social/

# ── Built vault: machine-generated from supabase/seed/** by the sync scripts
#    listed in scripts/lib/generated-content.mjs. Never hand-edited; `npm run
#    check:generated` fails if any of these drifts from its seeds. ───────────
apps/web/lib/longlive/content-vault.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/tracks.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/theories.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/videos.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/era-secrets.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/song-moods.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/clownbot-lore.generated.ts
apps/web/lib/longlive/merch.generated.ts

# ── App code (WIDENED 2026-08-11, Wyatt — docs/decisions.md). Gated by FULL
#    required CI green (`build`), not a human. View components, app pages, the
#    client/display lib subtree, and shared packages — plus colocated tests.
#
#    TIGHTENED 2026-08-12 (P0 security fix — red-team finding #1972). The lib
#    allow was `apps/web/lib/` (the WHOLE directory). That swept in the
#    server-side data layer (`apps/web/lib/vault.ts`) and the CSP/security-
#    headers module (`apps/web/lib/security-headers.mjs`), letting either
#    auto-deploy to prod with no human. The allow is now the CLIENT/DISPLAY
#    subtree only — `apps/web/lib/longlive/` — which is where the pure
#    view/formatting modules and the generated vault artifacts live. The
#    top-level `apps/web/lib/*` files (vault.ts, security-headers.mjs, hooks,
#    utils) fall back to human merge by default-deny. See docs/decisions.md
#    2026-08-12 and NEVER_ALLOWLIST in scripts/check-automerge-allowlist.mjs. ──
apps/web/app/
apps/web/components/
apps/web/lib/longlive/
packages/

# ── DENY carve-outs (`!` wins over any allow). These reinstate the human gate
#    for exactly the sub-paths that must NOT auto-merge even though a broad
#    allow above covers them. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Request-handling / data layer — held while E2E is red (#669); no behavioural
# regression net beyond unit+typecheck+build. Revisit when #669 is green.
!apps/web/app/api/
# Legal surfaces need counsel, not a code review.
!apps/web/app/privacy/
!apps/web/app/terms/
# The ONE server module inside the client/display subtree: mood-client.ts is
# "the one module that spends money" — it reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. It lives
# among pure display modules, so `apps/web/lib/longlive/` would otherwise sweep
# it in. Denied here by path, AND caught at runtime by the content guard below.
!apps/web/lib/longlive/mood-client.ts

# ── A path prefix CANNOT express two things that decide whether a file executes
#    server-side with secrets, so they are NOT (and cannot be) listed above —
#    they are enforced at merge time by scripts/automerge-content-guard.mjs (the
#    `guard-code` job in .github/workflows/auto-merge-content.yml):
#      1. A Next.js route handler is ANY `route.ts`/`.tsx`/`.js` under
#         `apps/web/app/`, not only under `/api/`. Three already exist outside
#         /api/ (apps/web/app/vault/{tier0,moment/[id],album/[slug]/tracks}/
#         route.ts). A `startsWith` deny cannot match a `*/route.ts` suffix.
#      2. A Server Action (`"use server"`), a `server-only` import, or a read of
#         a secret env var can appear in ANY app/ or lib/ file regardless of
#         path. The guard scans file CONTENT and declines such a PR to a human.
#    This is the durable fix for #1972 — see that guard's header. ──────────────
